requirements.title: SIZE= reports file size or -1 for an unconnected unit
requirements.definition: SIZE= is assigned the size of the file in file storage units; if the unit identified by file-unit-number is not connected to a file, it is assigned -1.

pending.size-file-storage-units: Open a stream file, write nonempty content, immediately inquire POS into a sentinel integer to obtain the one-past-terminal position, close KEEP, then inquire SIZE into a separate sentinel and assert only that SIZE is either POS - 1 or -1: 12.10.2.31 p2 defines the stream file size as the highest-numbered file storage unit, while 12.10.2.31 p1 assigns -1 if the file size cannot be determined.
pending.size-unconnected-unit-minus-one: Open and close a known unit, initialize SIZE to -777, inquire by unit, and expect -1.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive INQUIRE plans first establish the connection or file state being observed, initialize every inquiry variable to a nonmatching sentinel value, execute INQUIRE, and assert only values fixed by 12.10.2: exact tokens such as UNDEFINED or UNKNOWN, logical true/false where specified, zero/nonzero IOSTAT where 12.11 later permits it, or bounded set membership where the source gives a set. requirements.title: Stream-capable file size is the highest-numbered file storage unit
requirements.definition: For a file that can be connected for stream access, the file size is the number of the highest-numbered file storage unit in the file.

pending.size-stream-highest-numbered-storage-uni: Open a stream file, write nonempty content, record the one-past-terminal POS value, then inquire SIZE and assert only that SIZE is either POS - 1 or -1: POS - 1 is the highest-numbered file storage unit under 12.10.2.31 p2, and 12.10.2.31 p1 still permits -1 if the file size cannot be determined.

requirements.title: Sequential/direct file-size relationship to record data is processor dependent
requirements.definition: For sequential or direct access files, file size may differ from storage units implied by record data and the exact relationship is processor dependent.

pending.size-record-data-relationship-processor-: No portable oracle may require a byte count or storage-unit relation for sequential/direct records; future tests avoid comparing SIZE to record payload lengths.

requirements.title: SIZE= accounts for pending transfers as if completed
requirements.definition: If there are pending data transfers for the unit, SIZE= is computed as if all pending transfers had completed.

pending.size-pending-computed-complete: No portable oracle until a future asynchronous fixture establishes pending transfers and derives final size from prior INQUIRE positions without processor-dependent storage counts.

requirements.title: SIZE= -1 for inability to determine file size is processor latitude
requirements.definition: SIZE= is assigned -1 if the file size cannot be determined.

pending.size-cannot-determine-minus-one-latitude: No portable way to force inability to determine the size of a particular file; this latitude is recorded separately from the required -1 result for an unconnected unit.

accounting.rationale: SIZE= mixes required file-size and unconnected-unit -1 results with processor latitude for inability to determine file size.
Processor-dependent sequential/direct size relationship split as fine unit.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.10, the INQUIRE statement and all thirty-four inquiry specifiers (batch165). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across three rounds. Round 1 split the 'unable to determine' latitude out of eight YES/NO/UNKNOWN specifiers and out of ENCODING and SIZE; round 2 made the plans assert only what that latitude leaves portable - membership in {YES, UNKNOWN} for a method in use, and {POS-1, -1} for the size of a stream file. R1230, R1231 and C1247-C1251 were pre-accounted. With this packet Clause 12 is fully registered. Source accounting only.
